title: Chroma
tagline: Agent to agent decentralized intent solver for any on-chain operation
description:
we’re building an agentic settlement layer, kind of  an Agent to agent decentralized intent solver protocol for any on-chain operation. Basically you ask the agent to handle your wallet, and ask it to do onchain actions like transfer, deposit in a protocol or any other onchain action.
Then the agent will convert your wishes in an intent and broadcast it to the solver network (via gossip network Waku).
Here the solvers will receive the intent and answer with a way to solve it. After that the agent/user can confirm the proposed actions, sign them and send to the blockchain.
how_its_made:
The protocol will be focused in agents, so we will have an api for the agents to interact with chroma-agent to translate intents and manage the solvers operations.
We use eliza framework to build the chroma-agent that the other agents will interact with and  translate the intents. 
Waku gossip network (decentralized message protocol) to broadcast the intents and receive the proposals. 
Then the solvers could be in any technology that can listen and push messages to Waku (or any other network in the future) to answer proposals. Now it's integrated in the same Eliza for simplicity
